caption: The drawing depicts a long, cream-colored dress with a high waist and a full, floor-length skirt. The dress features large, puffed sleeves that taper tightly at the wrists, and the bodice has a gently rounded neckline. All over the dress, including the sleeves, bodice, and skirt, there are small, evenly spaced floral patterns featuring green foliage with red, blue, and purple flowers. The floral decorations are arranged in clusters and are scattered in a regular pattern across the fabric, contributing to the detailed appearance of the dress. The dress is rendered with shading to indicate folds and volume, enhancing the three-dimensional look of the garment. The background is plain and uncolored, allowing the dress to be the sole focus of the image.
title: Muslin Dress
